description: Deterministic context layer for your codebase: change impact, blast radius, answers with receipts.
name: ai.spiderbrain/spiderbrain

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the repository to serve, which must already contain a committed .spiderbrain/ folder. Set this: an MCP client's working directory is usually not your repository, and without it the server serves the working directory and reports that no understanding layer was found. Equivalent to passing --root.
environmentVariables.name: SPIDERBRAIN_ROOT

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables the cloud why-layer used by the sb_ask tool. The structural tools work offline without it.
environmentVariables.name: SPIDERBRAIN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base URL of the public brain registry this server consults on the first tool call when the repository has no committed .spiderbrain/ folder. Defaults to https://spiderbrain.ai/registry.
environmentVariables.name: SPIDERBRAIN_REGISTRY

packageArguments.description: Subcommand that starts the stdio MCP server. Without it the binary prints help to stdout and exits.

title: Spiderbrain
